items.title: Anthropic buys power for AI data centers in $3.4 billion deal: Report
items.description: The purchase is the latest sign of AI labs pushing deeper into the energy industry and bypassing intermediaries in the race to secure scarce power equipment.

items.title: PSU NMDC auctions over 2,000 carats of Panna diamonds
items.description: The Navratna public sector enterprise under the Ministry of Steel is targeting an annual iron ore production capacity of 100 million tonnes by FY30.
